name: Tempesta
source: Our protagonist, the assistant camp counselor, was once again making the evening rounds, checking the activity rooms for any late-returning pioneers. Same routine every night. Empty rooms, darkness, not a soul inside - everyone had long gone to sleep. However, it turns out one pioneer girl wasn't sleeping. But who is she, and why is she so eager to summon some kind of spirit?
